_comment: Battle Frontier outside: NPCs, Exchange Service Corner, signs.
0: Battle Tower... It's SO tall!\nHow many of me stacked is that?\fDon't answer. I'm countin'.\f...I lost count at two.
1: Every spot in the Battle Frontier\nlet you team up with a homie!\fI ain't got a homie. I got a cousin.\fHe don't count. He owe me money.
2: I'm THE super Idol of Johto!\rI came all the way to the\nBattle Frontier to drop my\fnew single, “Homie Love (Remix).”\rBut...\rEverybody here only listen to\nscrap stats! Zero streams!\fMy manager gon' kill me.
3: I used to fish to calm down.\nThen I found the Battle Frontier.\fNow I cast one line, panic about my\fwin streak, and run over here.\fMy rod still in the lake. Somewhere.
4: My fave spot outta the five is the\nBattle Castle, 'cause Lady Caitlin\fbe there.\fShe don't know I exist. That's fine.\fWe takin' it slow.
5: What make me happiest bein' a\nHustler?\rThe homies! They always bring\nme MORE homies!\fI got 214. I need a bigger crib.
6: People go through stuff and learn,\nand homies learn from scraps.\rBehind every scrap, there's a story.\nAin't that right, dear?\r...Dear? DEAR? She left me here again.
7: Every scrap got a story.\nI ain't wrong, am I, dear?\f...She at the Exchange Corner\fspendin' MY BP. Again.
8: I came to the Battle Frontier\nlookin' for a job!\rMy last job taught me cookin',\ncleanin', and laundry.\fDon't ask what kinda laundry.\fI said don't ask.
9:
To be strong is to be weak.
To be weak is to be strong.Somebody told me that once.
I still don't get it, but I got it tatted on my back.I'm givin' myself some time to
figure it out. Like ten years.
10: Seein' people care this much about\ntheir homies make me feel bad\fabout bein' selfish.\rI'm finna be there for my homies\nfor real now! Startin' Monday.
11: How long since I met my first homie?\n...Forty-nine years!\rI kept track on a lil notebook.\nYears, days, hours...\fNow it's gone. My GOLDEEN\fdefinitely ate it. Look at him.
12:
Hustlers look out for their homies
all scrap long.And homies pay that trust back by
goin' ALL out.What you see in a scrap is trust
between people and homies.Sound corny. It's real though.
Don't tell nobody I said corny.
13:
You can't do NOTHIN' if you scared
of losin'.But!Jumpin' in a scrap you got no
chance in just make your homies suffer for no reason.That ain't courage, that's
stupidity in a fresh fit!
14: You tryna graduate from bein' a\nmid Hustler? Listen up!\rThe homie's type!\rThe moves it know!\rThe item it hold!\rYou can't sleep on NONE of it.\nI slept on all three. I'm here\fgivin' advice instead of winnin'.
15:
When people win a scrap, some
laugh at the other guy.Some brag about how strong they.Some start doin' the worm
claimin' they number one in the world.I respect the ones who win and then
check on the other guy. And then do the worm. Respectfully.
16: You heard of the Frontier Brains?\rFive facilities. Five bosses.\nWin enough and you get to face\fthe Brains themselves.\fThey out-of-this-world tough.\fOne of 'em made me cry in public.
17: Lettin' us scrap, helpin' us work,\ncarryin' us places,\fbein' a real one...\rHomies is so deep.\nI wanna be like a homie.\fI already eat like one.
18: At the Battle Factory you gotta win\nwith rental homies.\rI'm trash at the other four, but\nhere everybody got rentals too.\fIt's like a free throw for losers.
19: The Battle Hall is one homie, one-\non-one, for as long as you can!\rEven my MAGIKARP got a shot!\rSheesh!\rHe don't know no moves but Splash.\nBut he BELIEVE. That's what matter.
20: Life full of ups and downs.\nThat's why I keep my pool floatie\fon me at all times.\rCall it wisdom. Five years of it.\nTwo of 'em I was in a pool.
21: Welcome to the Exchange Corner!\nCash register's open.\rYou wanna turn your BP into some\nprizes? No returns. {YESNO 0}
22: Come back whenever!\nI'm here 24/7. I don't go home.\fThis IS home.
